versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "model-usage-stats" skill.
- Provides token usage, cost statistics, and consumption reports by session and model.
- Visualizes data with Feishu (Lark) message cards (tables, summaries, charts).
- Supports queries for current session usage, historical session stats, model breakdowns, and exportable reports.
- Includes sample message templates, typical use cases, and reference pricing for supported models.
